stage: O4b sizing: the O4 gate re-costed for the G3 redesign, with the oracle and tau unchanged
not_a_precision_change: This re-run uses the existing O3 certified interval and tau = 3.0% unchanged, with no O3' re-freeze. Its purpose is to re-run the same O4 gate with a repaired G3 instrumentation contract, not to improve precision.

g3.cp_is: characterisation only, never an accuracy gate

measured_here: the lower probe's reach among eligible
census_design_input.is: a design input from a fixed stress set on a retired stream; NOT a probabilistic expectation about the new campaign's stream and NOT a passing condition

g3a_detail.measures: run_preflight, the single authority; the stage and this measurement read the same verdict
g3a_detail.basis: end-to-end measurement of run_preflight under the meter
g3a_detail.row_d_costs_nothing: row D proves the predicate never consults the solver, so it spends no calls by construction

budget.worst_case_is_an_upper_bound_because: the state calls are charged only on positive candidates, but nothing committed bounds that fraction and no rate is a guarantee about a new stream, so the bound charges every G1 point
budget.census_projected_assumes: fully-testable rate = 1, so the scan stops at K_G3B. The census measured ELIGIBILITY and the lower probe's reach, not the realized-margin and nudge conditions that fully-testable also requires, so this is a census-informed OPTIMISTIC projection and not a measured rate. If fully-testable falls short of eligible, the scan runs longer and the total rises toward the hard bound

cap_contract.kind: completion budget, not a power statement
cap_contract.not_invalid: a cap is a resource limit, not an instrument violation. INVALID belongs to contract failures wherever they occur -- G3a's cases AND a G3b probe that comes back undecided or boolean-mismatched
cap_contract.auto_raise: forbidden, during or after the run
cap_contract.charged_before_spending: the counter and the clock start before G3a and every call or bounded batch is reserved first; a cap checked after the calls were made is not a cap
cap_contract.why_not_resized: covering the hard worst case would reserve for 26.2M rejected candidates, wildly out of proportion to what the census saw; the honest move is to state that the cap can bind and to end INCONCLUSIVE when it does

outcomes.condition: G3a case fails (wrong tri-state, or the recovery or determinism check fails)
outcomes.when: before any fresh seed is touched

outcomes.condition: a fully-testable G3b probe returns None, or bool(a and b) != want
outcomes.when: the redesign calls this a contract failure and requires mismatch 0
tallied by reason and the scan CONTINUES; one candidate that cannot be probed says nothing about the stage

outcomes.condition: fewer than K_G3B fully-testable clusters by the end of the scan
outcomes.when: the sample was short, not the instrument wrong

outcomes.condition: the call or wall cap binds before K_G3B is reached
outcomes.when: a resource limit, not an instrument violation

outcomes.condition: provenance failure, or a solver exception
